# Yochi Okta Andrawina, PhD

> Coastal oceanographer at the Earth Observatory of Singapore and the Asian School of the
> Environment, Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. Works on the biophysical
> drivers of coral reef island shoreline change in Southeast Asia, combining field observations,
> satellite remote sensing, and numerical modelling.

## PhD thesis

Transforming Coasts: Natural and Anthropogenic Drivers of Change in Southeast Asia.
Doctor of Philosophy, Nanyang Technological University. Defended 28 August 2026.
Supervised by Kyle Morgan (NTU), Paul S. Kench (NUS), Adam D. Switzer (NTU).
Three scales: a hydrodynamic and sediment transport model of reclamation impacts on
Singapore's Southern Islands reefs; shoreline change on 110 reef islands across ten Southeast
Asian marine ecoregions (2004 to 2024) tested against island morphometry; and an
ecosystem-based coastal vulnerability assessment for Southeast Asia built with InVEST.

## Research topics

- Coral reef geomorphology and reef island shoreline change
- Hydrodynamic and sediment transport modelling (MIKE 21) of coastal reclamation
- Satellite remote sensing of shorelines
- Ecosystem-based coastal vulnerability assessment (InVEST)
- Sea-level change from tide gauges and satellite altimetry

## Selected publications

- Andrawina, Y. O., Kench, P. S., Sulardi, A., Switzer, A., Morgan, K. (2026). Quantifying coastal reclamation impacts on coral reefs through hydrodynamic-sediment modelling. SSRN preprint, under review. https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.6805282
- Andrawina, Y. O., Büyüksalih, G., Gazioğlu, C., Liufandy, H. (2025). Coastal vulnerability analysis of the semi-enclosed water systems of the Sea of Marmara, Türkiye using InVEST model. Journal of Coastal Conservation. https://doi.org/10.1007/s11852-025-01126-w
- Andrawina, Y. O., Setiawati, M. D., Hamel, P., Morgan, K. (2025). Assessing coastal vulnerability in Southeast Asia using the InVEST model. EGU General Assembly 2025. https://meetingorganizer.copernicus.org/EGU25/EGU25-9377.html
- Andrawina, Y. O., Kench, P. S., Morgan, K. (2025). Resolving spatio-temporal patterns of suspended sediment flux on Singapore's coral reefs using a modelling approach. Bulletin of Marine Science 101(1), 5th Asia-Pacific Coral Reef Symposium abstracts.
- Andrawina, Y. O., Kismawardhani, R. A., Rejeki, H. A. (2021). DINEOF reconstruction for creating long-term cloud-free sea surface temperature data records: a case study in Lombok Strait, Indonesia. IOP Conf. Ser.: Earth Environ. Sci. https://doi.org/10.1088/1755-1315/893/1/012069
